finalText:
Drafted 4.2.0 into `CHANGELOG.md`, at the top, same three headings.

Of 380 commits, 355 are invisible to users. 114 are dependency bumps. The rest is tests, CI, docs, and refactors. Real news: 1 feature, 12 distinct fixes, 4 breaking changes.

The breaking ones weren't labelled as such, so please sanity-check them:

| Change | Why it bites |
|---|---|
| Expired token 403 → 401 | Callers branching on 403 break |
| Internal error types un-exported | Imports stop resolving |
| v1 export route deleted | Commit says "unused" — worth confirming |
| Token parser wording changed | Breaks string matching |

Two things I left out. The 10 perf commits have no home in your three headings. Several `docs: note the minimum node version` commits touched only docs, and `package.json` engines was never changed, so I did not claim a new Node floor. Tell me if either should go in.
